component.name: Waffle
component.summary: Read and write Markdown in two rooms

description.p: Waffle is a Markdown reader and editor with two rooms: one for reading, one for writing. Each is built for its own job, and you move between them with a single key.

The reading room is a page: a comfortable column, a warm serif, a table of contents that follows you, and live task lists. The writing room is plain text with just enough styling to keep you oriented, with find and replace, formatting shortcuts and a focus mode. Switching rooms keeps your place to the line.
Documents are saved as you type, and any Markdown file can be opened, edited and saved back in place.

screenshot.caption: The reading room in the dark theme

description.p: The contents beside the page now widen to show long headings in full when the margin has room, instead of cutting them short.

Saving now asks first when the file was changed in another app since Waffle read it. Images given as Windows paths now show, printed pages leave out the toasts and screen padding, and exported HTML no longer carries copy buttons that do nothing. Binary files dropped on the window are turned away instead of opening as garbled text.
Images stored next to a document now show in the reading room. A new switch in the menu turns the contents off.
Waffle now keeps itself up to date outside Flathub. It downloads new releases in the background and offers a restart from the menu when one is ready.

Adds find to the reading room, a page width setting shared by both rooms, and a way to fold the table of contents away. Markdown files now open from the file manager, and a file opened while Waffle is running goes to the window already open.
Fixes flicker across the window when the documents drawer opens or closes.
Ships the launcher and AppStream metadata in the Linux packages, under the application id io.github.gingerbreadfork.waffle.
